record.question: Which of the following statements is correct about the 'Golden Dome' missile defence system announced by the US in May 2025?
options: The project aims to counter only cruise missile threats from Iran and North Korea.
It is a $175 billion project led by US Space Force and includes private companies like SpaceX and Palantir.
The system is inspired by Russia's S-400 and will be built entirely by the US military.
It is a joint project between the US and Israel to protect Europe from missile threats.
